value.rationale: For a hidden-attractor flow with coexisting stable equilibrium, the explicitly computed nonlinear observable P gives a complete almost-sure conditional mean law for every compact stationary state, not merely a pointwise algebraic check. It fixes an attained upper mean boundary with unique equality measure and a strict exact correction to mean volume contraction/Lyapunov sum in any other compact stationary regime. These quantify a dynamical gap precisely at the published chaotic parameters and give falsifiable observable constraints; no attractor existence is asserted.
